name: exact_resultant.py
mathematical_scope: Coefficient extraction and Sylvester determinant in h6 yield two exact resultant polynomials for W versus DB/DH. Nonzero reductions at a valid cyclotomic prime prove nonzero characteristic-zero polynomials.
input_and_guard_coverage: Requires canonical monomial tuples; coeff_x assigns rather than combines equal projected keys, safe only with canonical representations. Generic zero/constant resultant edge cases unguarded; intended W/DB/DH degrees are positive.
costs: Exponential-in-Sylvester-size subset determinant with potentially large sparse polynomial support/coefficient growth; actual target matrices have sizes 3 and 5, no all-N construction.
test_evidence: Checks three modular witness values and emits all coefficients. Independent SymPy tests sample only full-degree specializations.
acceptance_boundary: A nonzero resultant at the fixed base excludes the full regular x-slice; nonzero base polynomials merely constrain other base points and do not prove empty general solution locus.
findings: L48–50 asserts witnesses; L52 statement is valid only with exact source/data/equation provenance. Zero-polynomial generic resultant convention is not established.
